name: Assembly of Seven
tagline: The whole floor, day and night.
for: A busy business where messages arrive faster than people can answer, and the follow-ups are already slipping.

bots.why: Front-line tickets, photos read, policy checked.
Every lead greeted in seconds, scored into the CRM.
The day reconciled at 02:00, morning brief at 07:00.
Silent quotes and invoices chased on a ladder — day 3, 7, 14, 21.

notes: Bookkeeper (QuickBooks) can replace any agent seat at no charge for businesses that live in their books. The full night shift is included — this is the tier where the business runs while nobody's watching.
